[h1]Gods of Havoc heralds a return to the classic God-Game.[/h1]

Gods of Havoc is a three-part series offering difficult, turn-based strategy. Each game places the player as a god in different eras of a planet’s history.
 
[list]
[*] Fall to Earth: takes place in an early medieval setting;
[*] After the Fall: takes place in a post-apocalyptic one;
[*] Into the Void: takes place in a galactic scale.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1117340/Gods_of_Havoc_Into_the_Void/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1120770/Gods_of_Havoc_Fall_to_Earth/
 
‘Fall to Earth’ and ‘Into the Void’, are set to be released in August 2019 with ‘After the Fall’ to be released in December 2019.

Don't forget to wishlist for more news on all three games! Visit https://www.gods-of-havoc.com/ for more information!

notes.title: Movement Overhaul and Fixes
notes.content:
In this patch we have completely overhauled the movement system. No longer will the camera follow behind the player but will stay fixed on them. The reason for the original implementation of this was to create the scary effect of not knowing what was ahead, should you choose to move quickly, however it was giving some players a sort of motion sickness so it had to be removed.

Fixes:

* The new companions should no longer turn into Bruno (a new game is required for new companions to work correctly unfortunately)
* Companions should no longer randomly freeze for a few seconds after a kill and should immediately move on to the next enemy.
*  Certain random/comendy encounters should no longer play twice!

---------------------

If you have enjoyed this game please vote for it's sister game 'Moonstone Tavern' on Greenlight. We will definitely be creating a Steam Bundle for the two games so players who own this one will get a discount!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=651542337

notes.title: Friendly Fire Patch
notes.content:
After much consideration, and many requests, we have decided to implement FF safeties on all the weapons in the game, with the exception of Grenades (which we believe should be chaotic). However, you will no longer get shot by, or be able to shoot, your companions!

* This patch also increases balancing for zombie buildup, lowering it considerably.  


-----------------------------
I know this has been a contentious issue with people on both sides of the debate. This does make the game a lot easier. If you want a more challenging experience based in the same world you can try a game made by our sister company, which still has FF on.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/444420/

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9.3 and more
notes.content:
So after coming back from an extended family visit we have gotten back to work with another patch.

*  Super Soaker should now show up in inventory regardless of gender.
*  Zombie Buildup has been slowed massively.
*  Quest generation has been changed to reflect time spent in the world.

We are also planning to release a free DLC in early April that will allow for the recruitment of faction based allies and to that end we have changed the inner workings of the faction system. Soon you will be able to have aliens, mutants, and zombies on your team.

-----------------------

When we were building this game we were also developing a sister game with the same engine, 'Moonstone Tavern' - That game was completed at the same time but rather than launch 2 games at once we decided to stagger their releases.  We've now put that game onto Greenlight, so if you enjoyed this one and fancy playing it's sister game set in a fantasy world, then we would really appreciate your vote.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=651542337

notes.title: Apocalypse Hotel - The Thin Blue Line DLC!
notes.content:
As if zombies, mutants, and aliens weren't trouble enough, everyday humans are now causing trouble on the streets.

Help the re-established Swansea Police Force deal with these troublesome humans by repairing and renovating their police station, and by supplying them with a Policeman's Lounge at your hotel for them to relax after work.

Features:

- A new bar at your hotel just for police officers!
- A new world map area with Swansea Police Station.
- Build beds, cells and supply closets in the station to help boost the security of the city.
- Be gifted the 'Police Issue Desert Eagle' the strongest pistol in the city!
- As the city becomes more secure watch out for police stashes on the world map containing all sorts of goodies.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/446900/

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 [zombies expanded]
notes.content:
Firstly I'd like to apologise for the many unanswered PMs over the last few days. My wife and son have the flu so I'm playing nurse as well as trying to work. I promise I'll get back to you all over the next week.

Anyway... the patch...

This patch expands upon the randomly generated zombies. Firstly, it increases the sprites used in zombie creation from 20 to a whopping 50! You will now see medical personnel zombies, police zombies, fire service zombies, and more. Secondly, the zombies spawned will now spawn with a more diverse range of speeds, health points, skills, and sight range.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9 - Genetics Project
notes.content:
This patch allows you to significantly upgrade your undead pet.

From mini horde-spiders, through strange genetic blobs, to fire breathing dragons. Bruno has never been so hardcore!

•	Each pet skin gives Bruno different stats.
•	Humanoid pets can wear armour.
•	Different skins give Bruno different powers.

2. New enemies: The Zomtree and The Shade. 
     * Zomtrees are mutant trees usually found in parks. 
     * Shades are mutated humans that only come out at night.

3. New ingredients.
4. New Crafting.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 (Complete Rebalance)
notes.content:
This patch completely re-balances the combat system to make things easier.

1: Hyper Fast Enemies:
          Enemies that are significantly faster than you are now much less likely to spawn. At threat level 'GREEN' there is a 0% chance of them spawning in exteriors and a 1% chance of them spawning in interiors. At 'AMBER' there is now a 1% chance of them spawning in exteriors and a 3% chance in interiors. In the previous version the numbers were 7% in exterior 'GREEN' and 11% Interior, and 11% exterior 'AMBER' and 15% Interior. 'RED' and 'BLACK' threat levels have also been decreased.

2: Enemy Damage:
          This has been lowered by 33% in threat level 'AMBER', 25% in threat level 'RED' and 12% in threat level 'BLACK'

3: Mercenary Spawn:
           There is now an increased chance of mercenary spawns at higher threat levels giving you the opportunity to lower the threat through 'fuel' or by getting a terraformer quest.
